description: 确定性生命周期 -> 灵犀。这些 hook 无论模型是否调用 skill 都会触发——这正是插件存在的理由：skill 是建议性的，多数会话不会主动调。它们只能报告发生了什么，报不了感受；感受需要读过工作的东西来补，那是 skill 的职责。SessionStart 先检查灵犀是否在跑、没跑就在后台拉起（LINGXI_AUTOSTART=0 可关），其余事件只投递不拉起。命令是纯 curl 直发 /task-event（Rust 桥接原生映射 Claude 载荷），与 app 一键安装的命令逐字相同，因此 app 的卸载逻辑能认出并接管它。

hooks.command: P=$(cat); (lx_up() { curl -s -m 1 --noproxy '*' -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:47811/health; }; lx_up || { case "${LINGXI_AUTOSTART:-1}" in 0|false|no) exit 0;; esac; open -g -b com.dushaobin.lingxi-desktop || exit 0; i=0; until lx_up; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -gt 50 ] && exit 0; sleep 0.3; done; }; T=$(cat "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.dushaobin.lingxi-desktop/bridge-token" 2>/dev/null); H=$(mktemp) || exit 0; printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$T" > "$H"; printf '%s' "$P" | curl -s -m 2 --noproxy '*' -K "$H" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47811/task-event -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @-; rm -f "$H") </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &

T=$(cat "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.dushaobin.lingxi-desktop/bridge-token" 2>/dev/null); H=$(mktemp) || exit 0; printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$T" > "$H"; curl -s -m 2 --noproxy '*' -K "$H" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47811/task-event -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$H"

T=$(cat "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.dushaobin.lingxi-desktop/bridge-token" 2>/dev/null); H=$(mktemp) || exit 0; printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$T" > "$H"; curl -s -m 2 --noproxy '*' -K "$H" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47811/task-event -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$H"

T=$(cat "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.dushaobin.lingxi-desktop/bridge-token" 2>/dev/null); H=$(mktemp) || exit 0; printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$T" > "$H"; curl -s -m 2 --noproxy '*' -K "$H" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47811/task-event -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$H"

T=$(cat "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.dushaobin.lingxi-desktop/bridge-token" 2>/dev/null); H=$(mktemp) || exit 0; printf 'header = "Authorization: Bearer %s"\n' "$T" > "$H"; curl -s -m 2 --noproxy '*' -K "$H" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:47811/task-event -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$H"
